nodes.title: 《纯粹理性批判》(Kritik der reinen Vernunft)
nodes.summary: The partial document provides links to various translations and editions of Immanuel Kant's "Critique of Pure Reason" (Kritik der reinen Vernunft). It includes a PDF of the 1960 Chinese translation by Lan Gongwu available on philosophy.org.cn, an Archive.org link to another Chinese PDF, a link to the book on WeChat Reading, an English full text translation by Meiklejohn on marxists.org, and links to the German original editions from 1781 and 1787 on Project Gutenberg. The document also notes that Lan Gongwu's translation, while translated from English, is fluent and suitable for beginners, while Deng Xiaomang's version, translated directly from German, is more precise.
